intended_object: This is the "mean" part of the initial velocity field, built from a bundled `Input` structure inside the library's Euler packet-construction machinery (an internal blow-up/ill-posedness style construction). It has no standard counterpart in the literature. Inferred from the docstring and the surrounding file.
explanation: The definition only passes the fields of the bundled `Input` structure to the auxiliary construction `initializedInitialMean`, using the parameter `truncation k`. Its docstring just says "Mean, constructed using `initializedInitialMean`". It is a convenience wrapper for a technical intermediate object in a project-specific proof: one piece of a hand-built initial datum for the Euler equations. No standard mathematical notion exists to compare it against, so it is an implementation device rather than a mathematical object.
